source.title: Can you profit from prospecting? — original 500 Brilliant Silver Ore experiment
source.author: ForKalimdor-2740

quote: I bought 500 Brilliant Silver Ore from the AH, prospected it all
notes: Distinct firsthand PRE-2026-03-31-hotfix process/skill-context reference, not a yield study: the author reports purchasing exactly 500 Brilliant Silver Ore and prospecting that inventory. Ore quality/rank and exact item ID (237364 vs 237365), input item links, actually completed prospect casts, refunded ore, reprocessed Resourcefulness refunds, and outputs or quantities are NOT reported. 500 purchased ore must NOT be converted into 100 completed casts. Results expressed only as a sale/loss anecdote (gold figures intentionally omitted); no output group/rate should enter estimator. Author says Proficient Prospector, Prospector Pro and four sub-branches were maxed; spellings preserved as posted and point counts/actual skill unknown. Independent from Cardinalai June and Honeybone April source cohorts.
outputName: Unspecified outputs from Brilliant Silver prospecting
specialization: Reports Proficient Prospector, Prospector Pro and all four sub-branches maxed (names as authored)
